title: Embed deterministic CI video fixture

context.summary: Fix GitHub CI and release checks by removing ffmpeg encoder dependency from the integration video input fixture.
context.background: TASK-115 added encoder fallback, but the GitHub runner still failed while creating the MP4 test input. The product ffmpeg extraction path should remain covered without requiring CI to encode video.

in: Store a small deterministic MP4 test fixture as an ASCII base64 fixture file.
Load the embedded fixture in the video integration test instead of generating it with ffmpeg encoders.
Keep product ffmpeg keyframe extraction covered by the existing video processing assertions.
Validate tasks and repository checks before merge.
out: Changing release signing or GitHub repository settings.
Changing the public release version number.

acceptance_criteria: The integration test no longer depends on ffmpeg video encoders to create its input fixture.
The video processing integration path still uploads a real MP4 and verifies ffmpeg keyframe extraction.
Task registry includes TASK-116 and validates.
pnpm check passes locally before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm the GitHub release failure was in buildFfmpegVideoFixture before this change.

risks: GitHub release may reveal a later publishing-only issue after repository checks pass.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
